name: Juro
description_en:
Juro is a hosted contracting platform combining legally controlled templates, AI-assisted intake and review, approval, signature and an intelligent repository. Operator is its conversational contract interface, while AI Extract turns agreement content into fields used for views and reporting.

The useful selection question is whether business users can work within the legal team’s templates and rules while retaining searchable information after signature. Unlimited internal users are part of the stated pricing model; volume and deeper integrations still affect the commercial offer.
description_zh:
Juro 是托管合同平台，结合由法务控制的模板、AI 辅助申请及审阅、审批、签署和智能合同库。Operator 是其合同对话界面，AI Extract 则把协议内容转成视图及报表字段。

选型时应检查业务人员能否在法务模板和规则内工作，以及签后是否仍保留可搜索信息。官方计费模型包含不限量内部用户，但合同量和深度集成仍影响报价。

core_features.explanation_en: Business teams generate agreements from templates maintained by legal.
core_features.explanation_zh: 业务团队使用法务维护的模板生成协议。

core_features.explanation_en: AI Extract and table views support searching, reports and date-driven workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: AI Extract 和表格视图支持搜索、报表及按日期驱动的工作。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans describe unlimited users/workflows/templates, with volume and integration complexity affecting price.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐说明用户、流程及模板不限量，价格受合同量及集成复杂度影响。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Find renewal exposure across related agreements
sections.title_zh: 跨关联合同查看续约责任
sections.en: A finance evaluation could import a supplier master agreement and amendment, inspect extracted renewal fields and build a view of upcoming notice deadlines. Juro documents parent-child relationships, dynamic tables and pre/post-signature reminders. Check the source passage before treating an AI answer as the controlling term; a parent agreement and amendment may contain different dates. The proposed workflow was not executed.
sections.zh: 财务评估可导入供应商主协议和补充协议，复核提取的续约字段，并建立即将到通知截止日的视图。Juro 文档列有父子关联、动态表格及签前签后提醒。把 AI 回答当作有效条款前，应检查原文；主协议和补充协议可能含不同日期。本文未执行该流程。

sections.title_en: Check language scope and the source of an answer
sections.title_zh: 检查语言范围及回答来源
sections.en: The repository FAQ says AI Assistant and AI Extract support multiple languages, but AI contract review is currently English-only. Chinese editorial copy therefore does not establish Chinese review support or a Chinese interface. The FAQ describes source highlights and confidence levels, and lets users accept, edit or skip suggestions. Those controls help review; they do not establish the correctness of every extraction or redline.
sections.zh: 合同库 FAQ 说明 AI Assistant 和 AI Extract 支持多语言，但 AI 合同审阅当前仅支持英语。因此中文介绍不能证明支持中文审阅或中文界面。FAQ 还描述原文高亮、置信度及接受、修改、跳过建议的控制。这些有助复核，但不证明每次提取或修订都正确。

sections.title_en: Budget for volume and deeper integrations
sections.title_zh: 按合同量及深度集成预算
sections.en: The pricing FAQ states unlimited users, workflows and templates, with pricing based on contract volume and integration complexity. It names Slack, Google Drive and Companies House among available standard integrations, while Salesforce, HubSpot and Workday incur extra cost. Quotes can be provided in USD, GBP or EUR. No public payable amount was verified; request a quote that specifies the counted contract events, integrations, implementation support and AI scope.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 说明用户、流程及模板不限量，按合同量和集成复杂度报价。标准集成示例有 Slack、Google Drive、Companies House，而 Salesforce、HubSpot 和 Workday 另计费；可用美元、英镑或欧元报价。未核实公开应付金额，应在报价中明确合同计数事件、集成、实施支持及 AI 范围。

sections.title_en: Agree the template and data model before onboarding
sections.title_zh: 上线前确定模板和数据模型
sections.en: The sales process describes configuring a package, implementation help and integrations/SSO/API for scale. Start with an approved template, variables, an exception approval and a representative signed PDF. Compare who can create, change, approve and search each record. A generic integration logo is not evidence of a working custom mapping, and a public Operator demonstration does not grant production rights to the full platform.
sections.zh: 销售流程描述配置套餐、实施协助，以及扩展时的集成／SSO／API。可从批准模板、变量、例外审批和代表性已签 PDF 开始，核对谁能创建、修改、审批和搜索记录。集成 Logo 不能证明自定义映射可用，公开 Operator 演示也不等于获得完整平台生产权益。

sections.title_zh: 适合重复发生的业务合同工作
sections.en: Juro is relevant where legal needs controlled self-service and finance needs contract information after signature. A team requiring non-English AI review should resolve the documented language boundary first; occasional manual signing may not need this setup. The reviewed material describes a managed service, not a verified self-hosted or open-source package. Recovery, export fidelity, AI performance and exact contract-volume counters remain untested.
sections.zh: 需要受控自助起草、且财务需持续使用签后信息时，Juro 值得评估。需要非英语 AI 审阅的团队应先解决文档中的语言边界；偶尔手动签署可能无需这套配置。读取材料介绍托管服务，未核实自托管或开源安装包；恢复、导出完整性、AI 表现及具体合同计数器未测试。
